name: Silver Wolf
description:
A member of the Stellaron Hunters and a genius hacker.
She sees the universe as a massive immersive simulation game and has fun with it.
She's mastered the skill known as "aether editing," which can be used to tamper with the data of reality.

skills.name: System Warning
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Allow Changes?
skills.desc:
There is a #2[i]% base chance to add 1 Weakness of an on-field character's Type to the target enemy. This also reduces the enemy's DMG RES to that Weakness Type by #4[i]% for #3[i] turn(s). If the enemy already has that Type Weakness, the effect of DMG RES reduction to that Weakness Type will not be triggered.
Each enemy can only have 1 Weakness implanted by Silver Wolf. When Silver Wolf implants another Weakness to the target, only the most recent implanted Weakness will be kept.
In addition, there is a #5[i]% base chance to further reduce the All-Type RES of the enemy by #6[f1]% for #7[i] turn(s).
Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to this enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: There is a high chance to apply additional Weakness to one enemy and deals Quantum DMG to this enemy.

extra.name: Base Chance
extra.desc:
The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit.
The final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: User Banned
skills.desc: There's a #2[i]% base chance to decrease the target enemy's DEF by #3[f1]% for #4[i] turn(s). And at the same time, deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to the target enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: There is a high chance of lowering one enemy's DEF and deals massive Quantum DMG to this enemy.

extra.name: Base Chance
extra.desc:
The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit.
The final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Awaiting System Response...
skills.desc:
Silver Wolf can create three types of Bugs: Reduce ATK by #1[f1]%, reduce DEF by #2[f1]%, and reduce SPD by #3[f1]%.
Every time Silver Wolf attacks, she has a #4[i]% base chance to implant a random Bug that lasts for #5[i] turn(s) in an enemy target.
skills.simpleDesc: After this unit attacks, there is a chance of implanting the target with 1 random Bug.

extra.name: Base Chance
extra.desc:
The base chance of applying debuffs to targets hit.
The final probability is affected by the attacker's Effect Hit Rate and enemy targets' Effect RES.

skills.name: Force Quit Program
skills.desc: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Silver Wolf's ATK to all enemies, and ignores Weakness Types and reduces Toughness from all enemies. Enemies with their Weakness Broken in this way will trigger the Quantum Weakness Break effect.
skills.simpleDesc: Attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals minor DMG to all enemies and reduces Toughness of all enemies regardless of Weakness Types.

eidolons.name: Social Engineering
eidolons.desc: After using her Ultimate to attack enemies, Silver Wolf regenerates 7 Energy for every <u>debuff</u> that the target enemy currently has. This effect can be triggered up to 5 time(s) in each use of her Ultimate.

extra.name: Debuff
extra.desc: All status effects that provide negative combat debuffs, can be dispelled unless stated otherwise.

eidolons.name: Zombie Network
eidolons.desc: When an enemy enters combat, reduces their Effect RES by 20%.

eidolons.name: Payload
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Bounce Attack
eidolons.desc: After using her Ultimate to attack enemies, deals Quantum <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to 20% of Silver Wolf's ATK for every <u>debuff</u> currently on the enemy target. This effect can be triggered for a maximum of 5 time(s) during each use of her Ultimate.

extra.name: Debuff
extra.desc: All status effects that provide negative combat debuffs, can be dispelled unless stated otherwise.

extra.name: Additional DMG
extra.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

eidolons.name: Brute Force Attack
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Overlay Network
eidolons.desc: For every <u>debuff</u> the enemy target has, the DMG dealt by Silver Wolf to it increases by 20%, up to a max increase of 100%.

extra.name: Debuff
extra.desc: All status effects that provide negative combat debuffs, can be dispelled unless stated otherwise.

embedBonusSkill.name: Generate
embedBonusSkill.desc: The duration of "Bug" is extended by 1 turn(s). Every time an enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, Silver Wolf has a 65% <u>base chance</u> of implanting a random "Bug" on that target.

embedBonusSkill.name: Inject
embedBonusSkill.desc: The duration of the Weakness implanted by Silver Wolf's Skill increases by 1 turn(s).

embedBonusSkill.name: Side Note
embedBonusSkill.desc: If there are 3 or more <u>debuff(s)</u> affecting the enemy when the Skill is used, then the Skill decreases the enemy's All-Type RES by an additional 3%.

embedBonusSkill.name: Generate
embedBonusSkill.desc: The duration of "Bug" is extended by 1 turn(s). Every time an enemy's Weakness gets broken, Silver Wolf has a 100% <u>base chance</u> of implanting a random "Bug" on that target.

embedBonusSkill.name: Inject
embedBonusSkill.desc: When the battle starts, immediately regenerates 20 Energy. When Silver Wolf's turn starts, she regenerates 5 Energy.

embedBonusSkill.name: Side Note
embedBonusSkill.desc: For every 10% Effect Hit Rate that Silver Wolf has, additionally increases her ATK by 10%, up to a max of 50%.
